title: Let V be a simplicial object of the pro-etale slice over U, with singleton covering augmentation and canonical covering proper-face matching maps
statement: Let V be a simplicial object of the pro-etale slice over U, with singleton covering augmentation and canonical covering proper-face matching maps. If each underlying scheme V_n is isomorphic to the spectrum of a w-contractible ring, there is such a simplicial object W each of whose terms is literally a spectrum object of that form, with all covering and proper-face projection assertions retained.

source.place: Tag 09A1, lemma-w-contractible-hypercovering (2), final disjoint-union paragraph and choice of affine representatives

proof.text: Choose spectrum isomorphisms and transport each structure map to X and augmentation to U. Define every simplicial map by conjugation. Cancellation of adjacent inverse pairs proves identities and composition. Transport each proper-face diagram by the induced natural isomorphism, retaining the old cone point; the cone remains limiting. Compose the old matching arrow with the source isomorphism. Naturality gives every projection equation. Isomorphisms are singleton covers, and the precoverage is stable under composition, so augmentation and matching arrows remain covers. Empty spectra satisfy the same equations.

lean.statement:
theorem hypercover_spectrum_replacement (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.ProEt)
    (V : SimplicialObject (Over U))
    (hterm : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ D : CommRingCat.{u},
      IsWContractibleRing D ∧ Nonempty (Spec D ≅ (V _⦋n⦌).left.left))
    (hzero : Presieve.singleton (V _⦋0⦌).hom ∈ Scheme.ProEt.precoverage X U)
    (hmatch : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ (c : Cone (V.properFaceDiagram (n + 1)))
      (μ : V _⦋n + 1⦌ ⟶ c.pt), Nonempty (IsLimit c) ∧
        Presieve.singleton μ.left ∈ Scheme.ProEt.precoverage X c.pt.left ∧
        ∀ a : SimplicialObject.ProperFaceCategory (n + 1),
          μ ≫ c.π.app (op a) = V.map a.obj.hom.op) :
    ∃ (W : SimplicialObject (Over U)),
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ (D : CommRingCat.{u}) (f : Spec D ⟶ X) (hf : WeaklyEtale f),
        IsWContractibleRing D ∧ (W _⦋n⦌).left = @Scheme.ProEt.mk X _ f hf) ∧
      Presieve.singleton (W _⦋0⦌).hom ∈ Scheme.ProEt.precoverage X U ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ (c : Cone (W.properFaceDiagram (n + 1)))
        (μ : W _⦋n + 1⦌ ⟶ c.pt), Nonempty (IsLimit c) ∧
          Presieve.singleton μ.left ∈ Scheme.ProEt.precoverage X c.pt.left ∧
          ∀ a : SimplicialObject.ProperFaceCategory (n + 1),
            μ ≫ c.π.app (op a) = W.map a.obj.hom.op)
